Chapter 794: Chapter 13 World (Subscribe Please)_2

Chapter 794: Chapter 13 World (Subscribe please)_2

But even that couldn’t hide the heaven-defying nature of this Divine Ability—six seconds was enough to do quite a lot.

To be trapped inside an opponent’s Inner World for six seconds at the same level of power? It’s hard to imagine how many times one would be squeezed and squished.

“That’s too exaggerated,” Lin Yuan’s eyes slightly heated.

Compared to the previous four Physical Body Divine Abilities, the Divine Ability ‘World’ was purely offensive.

Once the Outer World has formed, Lin Yuan couldn’t move; he could only try to defeat the enemy within the maintenance interval of the world.

In contrast, even the Divine Skill ‘Enhancement’ had aspects for preserving life, like triggering ‘Enhancement’ to escape using increased speed.

...

“However, I like it.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

The Divine Ability ‘World’ depended entirely on one’s own Inner World, because the conjured Outer World was based on the Inner World as its foundation.

The stronger the Inner World, the stronger the conjured Outer World.

And the Inner World… that was Lin Yuan’s strongest advantage. Although the depth of space was temporary, the sheer size alone was more than twenty times that of his peers in the Main Universe.

The ‘more than twenty times’ referred to the diameter, and if converted into volume, it was indescribable how many times more it was.

This Physical Body Divine Ability was simply tailor-made for Lin Yuan.

“The most powerful application of the Divine Ability ‘World’ is self-destruction,” Lin Yuan thought rapidly.

If he couldn’t defeat his opponent in the first five seconds, then he would self-destruct in the sixth second.

Although the Outer World strictly followed the standards of the Inner World, it wasn’t the Inner World itself, but a replica quickly condensed by the Divine Ability ‘World’ using the Inner World as a ‘template’.

The size and power were consistent.

But it wasn’t the same entity.

Self-destruction of the Outer World didn’t mean self-destruction of the Inner World.

If Lin Yuan eventually triggered the self-destruction of the Outer World, at most he would suffer some backlash, a price much lighter than self-destruction of the Inner World.

Self-destruction of the Inner World was essentially a desperate move that meant mutual destruction.

Whereas self-destruction of the Outer World only resulted in some backlash.

The gravity of each choice was clear at a glance.

“With the foundation level of my true body’s Inner World, once I self-destruct the conjured Outer World, even the Four Divine Kings and other eleventh Rank Perfections of legendary life forms would undoubtedly die,” Lin Yuan thought privately, “and I would only suffer some backlash?”

This was still considering Lin Yuan was at the Tenth Rank; if he were promoted to Tier 11 and once again subjected to Chaos Void Origin Infusion, his Inner World’s foundation would skyrocket.

At that time, the power of self-destruction he could generate from the conjured Outer World was beyond Lin Yuan’s imagination.

“Such a move, I can only use once.”

Lin Yuan was well aware. His true physical form’s Inner World in the Main Universe reached a size of two hundred million square miles, therefore the conjured Outer World was of this range as well.

For an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse, if they figured out the essence of this move, staying over two hundred million miles away from Lin Yuan would be possible.

The attack range of an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse was counted in light-years, so a distance of over two hundred million miles was trivial.

Of course, easier said than done, Lin Yuan could completely conceal his presence, infiltrate within two hundred million miles of the enemy, then strike with the Divine Ability ‘World’.

…

“Next, the most important thing is to thoroughly comprehend this Divine Ability Imprint.”

Lin Yuan’s expression grew somewhat solemn.

Only by fully comprehending the Divine Ability Imprint could he take it to the Main World and imprint it on his True Spiritual Body.

The contribution of this Divine Ability to Lin Yuan’s combat power goes without saying; even if it meant sacrificing the time to understand the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules, he had to fully comprehend this Divine Ability Imprint first.

The Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules could be comprehended anywhere in the Main Universe, or even in other traversed worlds.

But the ‘World’ Divine Ability Imprint could only be comprehended through this Martial Ancestor Golden Body.

…

Outside the Tianqing World.

The boundless expanse of the Void.

The Black Demon Pavilion Master and three friends were hastening toward the Tianqing World.

An immense and terrifying aura emanated from these four Outer Domain Evil Gods.

All along the way, despite the vast distances, it caused the hearts of other Outer Domain Evil Gods to tremble.

“Is that the Black Demon Pavilion Master?”

“Apart from the Black Demon Pavilion Master, there are also three equally powerful Evil Gods!”

“What could have happened? Wasn’t the Black Demon Pavilion Master in closed cultivation?”

“Hehe, the Black Demon Pavilion Master must be heading to the Tianqing World. Previously, two members of the Black Demon Pavilion fell within the Tianqing World.”

…

Numerous Outer Domain Evil Gods watched from afar, the influence of the Black Demon Pavilion Master was just too great, instilling fear in many Outer Domain Evil Gods. Moreover, the fact that he was traveling with three other powerful Evil Gods only added to the concern.

…

“Black Demon, what secret does that world hold that you are taking it so seriously?”

“Indeed, what is it that requires us all to go together?”

“Black Demon, you can decide if we join forces, but we can’t go on a fruitless trip.”

The three ‘friends’ of the Black Demon Pavilion Master exchanged thoughts rapidly as they continued toward the Tianqing World.

As Outer Domain Evil Gods, they were not known to rise early without cause, expecting them to help the Black Demon Pavilion Master seek revenge for free? Absolutely not.

“Don’t worry, the secrets contained in that world are substantial, enough to rapidly increase the power of the World Origin. As long as we take down that world, I am willing to share this secret with you,” the Black Demon Pavilion Master glanced at his three ‘friends’ and continued, “Moreover, I can let you join me in entering that Void Secret Realm afterward, to explore the opportunities within together.”

“Good.”

“It’s generous of you, Black Demon.”

“I will definitely help you with this revenge.”
